protocol: Headless Chrome file-backed getUserMedia, MediaPipe tracking, separate-site auto capture/quality gate, controlled 34-class model routed into isolated test browser. No predictions or landmarks injected.
source_independence: Local media mostly ASL Citizen/PopSign, not CLERC keypoint files; exact signer/source duplicate exclusion cannot be proven without CLERC raw videos. YOUR CLERC demo clip excluded.
